The full printed title adds the subtitle "Archival and Experimental Evidence for the Perceived Association Between Masculinity and Creative Thinking" to the neutral reference title. The text includes methods, results, discussion, and references, rather than only an abstract or secondary excerpt. No PDF was supplied.
